scope.purpose: Tulu 1B joint-transfer pilot with TLDR-aligned role-bank training, singleton audit, exact-subset composition, and no DPO retraining
scope.supersession_scope: the Tulu 1B joint pilot only; it does not amend the separately locked formal Performance V3 protocol

split.algorithm: construct source-row index lists separately by task, then call random.Random(42).shuffle(indices) once per list
split.rlvr_admission_before_shuffle: keep task rows with a non-empty user prompt and non-empty ground_truth; record every rejected source row
split.gsm_pair_candidates: all remaining shuffled GSM8K rows after selector, head_audit, and alpha_dev
split.joint_pair_order: within train and validation separately, concatenate admitted gsm8k and ifeval rows then apply random.Random(42).shuffle once

data_cleaning.tokenizer: the pinned SFT tokenizer with its embedded chat template
data_cleaning.admission: both chosen and rejected endpoints must fit; every rejection is recorded and the frozen source order is refilled

gsm_pair_construction.chosen: lowest sample_index with official-compatible numeric exact score 1
gsm_pair_construction.rejected: lowest sample_index with official-compatible numeric exact score 0
gsm_pair_construction.refill: continue in frozen shuffled prompt order until the fixed admitted count is reached

reuse_policy.selector_trajectories: may be imported only when their prompt bytes, model revision, generation settings, candidate identity, and recorded SHA256 all match
must_rebuild: independent target_support and competitor_support K8 banks
reuse_policy.reason: expanding head-audit and alpha-development roles to 100 changes role boundaries and the downstream GSM pair-candidate stream; V6 also trained one shared K16 bank

rcm_selector.state_constructor: zero one candidate at every generation decision state
rcm_selector.behavior_edge: registered task success over task failure under the native task prompt
rcm_selector.positive_role: strictly positive mean delta is target_support
rcm_selector.negative_role: strictly negative mean delta is competitor_support
rcm_selector.ranking: target parent beam by descending ci95_low; competitor-search parent beam by ascending ci95_high; final head roles and ranks use each head's own signed effect

gsm8k.scope: native and all 16 completed layer-zero trajectories only

ifeval.scope: native and all 16 completed layer-zero trajectories only

gsm8k.scope: all 128 completed head-zero trajectories over the unchanged GSM8K parent-layer union

rcm_selector.head_refinement: scan every head in the union of each task's four positive and four negative parent layers; head role comes from its own mean effect
rcm_selector.cross_task_dedupe_refill: fixed round-robin order gsm8k-target, gsm8k-competitor, ifeval-target, ifeval-competitor; duplicate heads are skipped and refilled only from the same task-role ranking
rcm_selector.trajectory_storage: save native and every layer/head zeroed open generation with per-sample task score and paired delta

actuator.sites: two independent eight-head signed role banks: target_support and competitor_support
actuator.training_count: exactly two independent role-bank trainings; both consume the same full shuffled 8192-train/512-validation mixed pair corpus

head_audit.operating_point_selection: for every head and task, maximize the registered task score over the full head-audit grid; exact ties choose the smaller alpha
head_audit.side_effect_filter: drop a head whose best singleton operating point harms the other task unless its own-task gain beyond the best available nonharmful quota boundary is strictly greater than max(0.01, absolute cross-task harm)
head_audit.preliminary_selection: after filtering, select four GSM-source heads by GSM peak gain and four IFEval-source heads by IFEval peak gain
head_audit.additive_gate: sum the eight selected singleton gains separately for GSM8K and IFEval; both sums must be strictly greater than zero
head_audit.replacement: if the preliminary K8 fails, replace only selected heads with negative gain on a failing task; minimize replacement count, require both additive sums positive, then maximize own-task gain and safety with deterministic head-id ties
head_audit.composition: take exact unscaled tensor subsets from the independently trained role banks; no singleton training, no K8 retraining, and no composition of singleton audit alphas

alpha_dev.selection: within each task, maximize the registered score over the full grid; exact ties choose the smaller alpha
alpha_dev.operating_point_scope: after K8 is frozen and recomposed from raw tensors, jointly rescale all eight heads with one separately frozen common alpha per task

dpo_transfer.rule: apply the exact SFT-selected two-role K8 payloads and each task's SFT-selected alpha unchanged to the pinned DPO checkpoint
dpo_transfer.purpose: measure whether CAST natively augments DPO without retraining
